welcome.title: Welcome to KitchenProof
welcome.subtitle: Create your company to get started.

programme.title: Own-check programme
programme.startHint: Creates a draft risk analysis from the official template for your activity type — with suggested equipment and control points. You review and approve before anything goes live.
programme.approveHint: Approval activates the daily task schedule. Only site managers can approve.
programme.approvedToast: Programme approved — task schedule is live

errors.criticalNoCp: A critical activity has no active control point — the programme cannot be approved.
errors.justificationRequired: Loosening a pack limit requires a written justification.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

programme.justificationHint: Required if you loosen the pack's default limit (§7.3).
programme.startWizardHint: The AI guide interviews you about your routines and drafts the risk analysis. You review and approve everything before anything goes live.

rowEdit.whatCanGoWrong: What could go wrong and what is the associated risk?
rowEdit.controlMeasures: What process controls do you have to ensure food safety?
rowEdit.ifItGoesWrong: What do you do if something goes wrong?

programme.startImportHint: Already have a risk analysis on paper, in Word or PDF? Import it — the original is stored and the content is transferred to the official form.

cooling.blastChiller: Blast chiller — done in one step

today.title: Today
today.placeholder: Your daily tasks will appear here (Phase 2).

today.onlyManagerHint: Only a site manager can register this device.

pin.locked: PIN is locked. Ask a manager to unlock it.

offline.fallbackHint: No connection. You can still do today's checks — they sync when you're back online.
offline.noCache: No cached tasks on this device yet. Open 'Today' while online.
offline.updateReady: New version ready — reload to update

wizard.title: AI self-control guide
wizard.hint: Answer a few questions about your routines — the guide drafts your risk analysis and control points. Everything is marked as an AI suggestion until you have reviewed it.
wizard.generating: Drafting — this can take up to a minute …
wizard.generateHint: The draft must be reviewed and approved before the task schedule goes live. AI can never loosen limits.
wizard.fallbackApplied: AI was unavailable — the standard template was applied instead
wizard.limitsClamped: {count} AI limit proposals were rejected (never looser than the pack)
wizard.aiUnavailable: The AI guide is unavailable right now. You can start from the standard template instead — same result, adjusted by you.
wizard.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again or start from the template.
wizard.useTemplateInstead: Go to the programme and use the template
wizard.equipmentPhotoHint: Tip: add photos of your fridges and freezers under Equipment — they'll be ready with QR codes once the programme is approved.

importRa.title: Import risk analysis
importRa.hint: Photograph the paper form or upload PDF/Word/Excel. Content is read into the official form — empty cells stay empty, and you review everything before anything is saved.
importRa.acceptHint: Accepted files: photos (JPG/PNG), PDF, DOCX, XLSX — max 20 MB per file.
importRa.reviewHint: Compare each cell with the original (page number shown per row). Empty cells are NOT filled in automatically — add content yourself if it's missing. Edit directly in the fields.
importRa.noGaps: No gaps found — still review the content before confirming.
importRa.gapMissingSection: Section "{section}" is missing — expected for your activity type
importRa.gapEmptyCritical: Critical row "{row}" is missing control/corrective content
importRa.gapLowConfidence: Uncertain reading of "{row}" (page {page}) — check against the original
importRa.gapUnreadable: Checkbox in "{row}" could not be read — set it yourself
importRa.emptyCellPlaceholder: Empty cell — only fill in if it belongs here

cells.whatCanGoWrong: What could go wrong and what is the associated risk?
cells.controlMeasures: What process controls do you have to ensure food safety?
cells.ifItGoesWrong: What do you do if something goes wrong?

importRa.missingSectionPrompt: Do you do anything under "{section}"? Add a row yourself — we never fill it in for you.
importRa.confirmHint: Creates a draft risk analysis with provenance to the original (import, page, region). Approval follows as normal.
importRa.confirmedToast: Import confirmed — the draft is ready for review

errors.aiUnavailable: Extraction is unavailable right now — try again later, or build the programme with the guide/template.
errors.badFile: The file could not be used — check the type and size (max 20 MB).

receive.title: Receive goods
receive.hint: Photograph the invoice or delivery note — the goods are read automatically and stocked with full traceability. You review everything before anything is saved.
receive.quickHint: For market purchases and deliveries without an invoice — pick supplier and products, still 100% traceable.
receive.duplicateWarning: This invoice looks like one already registered (same supplier and invoice number). Check before confirming — otherwise the goods are counted twice.
receive.totalMismatchWarning: The lines don't add up to the printed total (about {pct}% off). Check quantities and prices against the original.
receive.receivingHint: One entry — recorded both as the receiving check (self-control) and on the goods receipt (traceability).
receive.addProductPlaceholder: Pick a product from the catalog
receive.noProductsHint: The catalog is empty — it grows automatically when you confirm your first invoice.

errors.aiUnavailable: Extraction is unavailable right now — use quick receive, or try again later.
errors.badFile: The file could not be used — check type and size (max 20 MB).
errors.noActor: First choose who you are (PIN) — receipts are person-attributed.
